metadata.methods_description: 64-channel wet-electrode EEG (10-20 system, FCz reference) was recorded together with ECG (right clavicle and left shinbone) and EDA (middle and ring fingers of the non-dominant hand). A BrainAmp DC amplifier from BrainProducts was used at 500 Hz, 16-bit resolution, with a 0.016 Hz high-pass filter. Stimuli were presented with Psychtoolbox in MATLAB on a 27-inch monitor. Each of 56 images was rated on nine scales (504 trials) in two blocks separated by a break, with 3-minute eyes-open baselines at the start and end.
